headline: Syngenta 9-Month Global Sales Fall 5% Amid Latin American Ag Pressures
summary: Grupo Syngenta reported global sales of $17.3 billion for the first nine months of 2026, down 5%, while EBITDA rose 1% to $3.2 billion. The company cited agrochemical price pressure, high interest rates, and weather issues in Latin America.
why: Syngenta is a major global player in agricultural inputs, crop protection, and seeds, offering insights into farm-sector health, commodity demand, and regional macroeconomic pressures.

impacts.name: Grupo Syngenta
impacts.why: Lower global sales driven by regional headwinds directly reflect negative top-line performance for the company.
